Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the E-commerce Operations Specialist role at your international retail group. With a hands-on background in digital marketing, SEO, and web operations, I am eager to bring my operational mindset and cross-functional coordination skills to your e-commerce team.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, content publishing, and WordPress site builds for client websites, ensuring smooth digital experiences. My experience includes tracking performance with analytics tools, resolving technical issues, and collaborating with various stakeholders. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical audits to improve search visibility, demonstrating my proactive approach to operational excellence.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and actively improving. Based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing omnichannel retailer. I am confident that my analytical skills and customer-focused mindset align well with your needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your e-commerce operations.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the E-commerce Operations Specialist position at your international retail group. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web operations, I am drawn to the hands-on, cross-functional nature of this role and the opportunity to ensure a seamless online customer journey.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, content publishing, and WordPress site builds for client websites. This involves daily monitoring of site performance, resolving technical issues, and coordinating with team members to maintain operational quality. I use tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Google Search Console to track KPIs and identify areas for improvement. Additionally, I maintain CRM records for a cleaning-services client, ensuring data accuracy and follow-up.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and conducted iterative technical audits. This experience honed my ability to proactively identify root causes and implement corrective actions, resulting in improved search visibility. I thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy collaborating with IT, customer service, and logistics teams to solve problems.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and actively taking classes to improve. My background in front-end development and warehouse logistics has given me a practical understanding of both digital and physical operations. I am analytical, structured, and solution-oriented, and I am eager to contribute to your e-commerce initiatives.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
